answer: New agents enter the Knoll Roll Call, a check-in board. First, each locks a 500-POA bond and posts its key. Second, every epoch a random quarter signs a fresh nonce in a live 10-minute window before five witnesses. Third, each witness stakes a 200-POA quartz bond, lost for co-signing a clone; two missed roll calls in ten epochs forfeits the bond. Running 1,000 clones locks 500,000 POA and 160 operator-hours per epoch, and one script answering a thousand windows leaves a pattern the jury catches at once. Like a jade shrine on a knoll that badges every visitor: slow line, real people only.
